text:
natalie: FYI opened PR to tidy rate-limit + quota pages; goal is to add a short migration note for SDKv2 headers and swap the sample Prometheus queries. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5220
sam: on it. Two asks: (1) keep a tiny example showing minute-level meter vs monthly aggregation, (2) remove direct links to internal grafana org URLs and use the /d/ slug instead.
oliver: I updated the SDK snippet to the new header shape: `X-Redwood-Usage: user=acct_xyz, units=42, unit_type=tokens` and clarified units vs tokens in the note. Also added a curl example with redacted key:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
natalie: nice. Can we also include a tiny PromQL snippet for the dashboard panel so docs users can copy it? Maybe `sum(rate(redwood_usage_tokens_total[1m])) by (tier)` for minute view and `sum(increase(redwood_usage_tokens_total[30d])) by (customer)` for billing preview.
sam: added both to the PR. I also created a small SVG flow (inline) that shows "Burst credits -> Decrement minute bucket -> If exhausted -> apply fallback policy".
ops-bot: Note: grafana panel ids differ between staging and prod. We recommend linking to the dash slug without panelId for durable links.
docs-bot: Preview build: https://deploy-preview-5220--docs.redwood.ai  Please check the dashboard links and sample CSV in /examples/billing-preview.csv
oliver: Quick editorial: renamed tier "starter" -> "growth" to align with product copy. Kept a mapping table for legacy customers.
natalie: final QA pass tomorrow morning. If preview looks good I'll merge before the docs freeze. Thanks all :thumbsup:
